🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Sergiu Ardelean über AR und das Beleben durch Narrative. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 173. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 11.08.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten. 

©Congerdesign 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/7MvGL7qkB  

#KunstUndWirtschaft #KulturUndWirtschaft #Kulturmanagement #Kreativwirtschaft

I post here frequently.  This is something a little different. It's a positive thing m

"Being truthful means being good.  It's not easy.  Until I started paying attention,  I didn't realize how often I did lie, sometimes for no reason.  
That changed.  It has to before you can really be honest with yourself.  
That may be a rabbit hole.  But, clearing it and owning your life.  What's your fault.  What was somebody else's, or the circumstances.  
If you have the consequences,  own it, bones and all. 
Don't swallow hard feelings.  Secrets are most likely to become regrets"

sharedPost.text:
Being truthful means being good.  It's not easy.  

Until I started paying attention,  I didn't realize how often I did lie, sometimes for no reason.  

That changed.  It has to before you can really be honest with yourself.  

That may be a rabbit hole.  But, clearing it and owning your life... that's the challenge to being alive and living. 
 
Watching a beautiful sunset or hearing one. 

What's your fault?  What was somebody else's, or can circumstances justify everything?
 
If you have the consequences, how little does all that  matter?

Don't swallow hard feelings. They will come back as repressed traumatic memories  

A final thing to consider...

Secrets are most likely to become regrets. Think it through, then Google it

Cosplay/er, a Horror Movie Born in Cosplay Culture

 

Cosplay/er is an independent horror feature filming in St. Petersburg, Florida in April 2027. The project is seeking actors (lead and supporting roles), extras, cosplayers, film crew, and volunteers. Portions of the film will be shot during St. Pete Comic Con 2027, creating an authentic convention atmosphere unlike anything that can be recreated on a soundstage.

 

The movie's crush-worthy characters and application forms can be found at the website: [https://cosplayslasher.com/](https://cosplayslasher.com/)

 

While not required for consideration, there are two in-person casting calls at fan conventions: Sunshine City Scare on August 15-16, and Holiday St. Pete on Nov. 21-22 - both at the Hilton St. Petersburg Bayfront. Registration is preferred. There are no fees associated with the casting calls or any other movie info sessions, but an event ticket is required for entry (tickets are affordable- $25 per).

Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role:

Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

I can offer £15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over the City of Milton Keynes.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.3 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline starting August.

Thank you for taking the time to read this. — at Milton Keynes.

Voiceover Ireland is delighted to announce a new collaboration with @Graveyforthebrain 

Gravy For The Brain is one of the world's leading voiceover education and career development platforms, supporting thousands of voice actors across the globe through world class training, business resources, mentoring and an incredible international community.

They are also the organisation behind the internationally renowned One Voice Conference & Awards, the world's premier voiceover conference. Held annually in both the United Kingdom and the United States, the event brings together some of the biggest names in animation, gaming, commercial, promo, audiobook and performance voiceover for world class education, networking, showcases and industry recognition.

Voiceover Ireland is especially honoured to be working alongside Hugh Edwards, CEO and Co Founder of Gravy For The Brain. Hugh is an award winning voice director, casting director, producer and BAFTA Awards judge who has worked on hundreds of video games, films and television productions. As one of the industry's leading educators and innovators, he has helped shape the careers of voice actors around the world while continuing to champion excellence across the global voiceover community.

This collaboration marks an exciting new chapter for Voiceover Ireland as it continues to build stronger links between Ireland's voiceover community and the international industry.

Together, Voiceover Ireland and Gravy For The Brain will create more opportunities for Irish voice talent to learn, connect and grow with some of the very best professionals in the business.

This is only the beginning, with exciting announcements and opportunities to come.

# **[KRAKÓW] PROWADZĄCA / WSPÓŁAUTORKA PODCASTU WIDEO**
## **Tworzę w Krakowie profesjonalny, kobiecy kanał podcastowy (gdzie pod wspólnym, silnym szyldem funkcjonują różne autorskie pasma). Zamiast budować małe kanały od zera, łączymy siły, krzyżujemy widownie i rośniemy wielokrotnie szybciej.**

Szukam do tego projektu współtwórczyń, które chcą poprowadzić swój własny, niezależny format.

Jak wygląda nasz podział ról?
* Twoja działka: Jesteś jedyną twarzą, głosem i szefową swojego formatu. Dostajesz własną playlistę. Wchodzisz do studia i skupiasz się wyłącznie na rozmowie. Zapraszasz gości, dzielisz się wiedzą i budujesz swoją markę osobistą.
* Moja działka (Produkcja i Technologia): Pełnię rolę Twojego producenta i realizatora. Zdejmuję z Ciebie 100% technicznego stresu. Dysponuje studiem wideo (wielokamerowy system na pełnoklatkowych aparatach Lumix, miksery ATEM). Ogarniam też przygotowanie krótkich form (Shorts, Reels) do promocji.

***Model biznesowy (Zasady 50/50):***

Nie płacisz mi za wynajem studia ani za sprzęt. Budujemy wspólne przedsięwzięcie i dzielimy się zyskami wygenerowanymi bezpośrednio przez Twoje odcinki (przychody z YouTube, kontrakty sponsorskie w Twoim formacie, lokowania) dokładnie po połowie (50/50). Ty masz program bez wkładu finansowego, ja inwestuję swój sprzęt i wiedzę w nasz wspólny sukces.

Żeby sprawdzić nasze biznesowe dopasowanie przed kamerą, współpracę zaczniemy od krótkiego sezonu pilotażowego.

***CZEGO WYMAGAM NA START (Przeczytaj uważnie):***

Zależy mi na kobietach, które podchodzą do swoich pomysłów z pełnym profesjonalizmem. Jeśli widzisz w tym potencjał, wyślij mi wiadomość prywatną. Oczekuję maksymalnego konkretu. Twoja aplikacja musi opisywać:
* Format i tematykę: Jaki dokładnie podcast chcesz prowadzić i do kogo ma trafiać? (Ważna uwaga: dbając o bezpieczeństwo i profesjonalizm kanału, omijamy tematy mocno polaryzujące, takie jak ostra polityka, skrajne wojny płci, internetowe dramy czy niesprawdzona pseudonauka).
* Twarde kompetencje: Dlaczego to właśnie Ty powinnaś o tym mówić? Wymagam jasnego potwierdzenia Twojej wiedzy (wykształcenie, doświadczenie zawodowe, zrealizowane projekty lub biznes).
* Bazę gości: Czy masz własną sieć kontaktów (znajomych, współpracowników, ekspertów), których od razu będziesz w stanie zaprosić do udziału w swoim programie?

Połączmy Twoją wiedzę z moją produkcją. Stwórzmy razem miejsce, gdzie dobre, kobiece rozmowy dostaną zasięgi, na jakie zasługują. Czekam na Twoją wiadomość.

items.text: I had an audition today. I sent my reel with my submission and then they invited me to an appointment to read sides prepared. I came prepared but kind of blanked out at times and would have to regroup myself. Then after they had me read both sides. I really feel I didnt do great and did not do as good as I really truly could. The director of the feature film said good job and I believe the other was the producer and she asked me questions about my schedule and asked if I could work on certain days and if I had somewhere to stay on the weekends that was just a bit closer to filming and I confirmed I did at my cousins house. I’m not sure if this was procedural. The auditions were by appointment only and when I went in no one was coming in and no one was coming out. Was this a call back? And I know we are supposed to forget about it but it was my first in person audition. It was for a lead role. So I’m just anxious. Would they generally ask you all of these questions as being procedural? They didn’t ask me to do any retakes so I don’t take it as the most positive sign but not too negative either.

topComments.text:
If this was your first time reading for them, then it probably was an audition. Usually, callbacks are the 2nd (or more) time reading for them. But, who knows. 

In my experience, they rarely let you know one way or the other… and it may even be months before you find out… the last people hired on a film may be the actors (although, if they can get a big name on early in the production, that helps secure funding). There is a lot of pre-production that happens before they offer a role. It could be as little as 2 days notice before filming starts that you get offered the role… and it upends your life. 

Or you may find out someone else got the role, once they start advertising for the release of the film. 🤣 

Being an actor is a lot of hurry up to do such and such, and then wait to hear back (if ever).

Good luck!

Congratulations! Sounds to me like there was some extra time and attention paid on their part. Hope for the best! Your hope can propel you towards any opportunity. The general public doesn’t have that hopeful sparkle at the moment and it’s VALUABLE!

Lokacja zdjęć: Warszawa 

 Ilość dni zdjęciowych: 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe (w zależności od roli) - 18-19 sierpnia 🎬🎥✅

 Prawa / Usage Rights: 1 rok 

 Terytorium emisji: INDIE (Brak emisji w Polsce / Europie / UK)

 Pola eksploatacji: TV, Digital, Internet, Social Media

ROLE GŁÓWNE (HERO ROLES) — 1 000 USD / dzień z prawami 

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. REŻYSER (THE DIRECTOR) —

items.text:
Casting Call for Actors in Yorkshire & surrounding area!

'The Hawthorne Job' - an ambitious short 360-degree Virtual Reality film, blending classic British storytelling and traditional filmmaking techniques with the cutting edge of immersive technology. This experimental short film is part of a PhD by Creative Practice research project at the University of York.

Shooting in York in early September 2026 across 2-days,(dates TBC, during the w/c 31st August and w/c 7th September). On-set rehearsals in York prior to filming, across 1-2 days, (dates to be discussed). 

Micro-budget project: food & travel expenses covered + a small participation fee for all cast.

Directed by myself, a PhD researcher at the University of York, this project experiments with how traditional film directing methods can be reimagined in Cinematic Virtual Reality: a 360-degree format viewed through a head mounted display that transports viewers inside the story. 

Set in the 1900s Northern England, 'The Hawthorne Job' follows a heist crew attempting a high-stakes manor house robbery gone wrong. As the story unfolds, viewers discover it wasn't greed or bad luck that caused the heist to fail, it was betrayal from within. Told partially as a flashback, the film draws the audience into the mystery where every glance, sound and movement guides them towards uncovering the truth.

CONNOR/SERGEANT CONNOR (Male, mid-late 30s) 

A composed man with an imposing demeanour. A dual faced character - bold inside man on the heist, undercover cop in truth. Character inspiration: Orange - Reservoir Dogs (1992)

STAN (Male, late 30s)

A sharp-featured and intelligent man who is dangerously calm, but his piercing gaze and confident demeanour portray his authority. The ringleader - charming, confident and in love with the thrill of the crime. Character inspiration: Danny - Ocean's 11 (2001)

LOUIS (Male, late 20s)

The brains of the group, an intellectual man who knows just how indispensable they are. The lock picker - determined, smart and skilful, but a little arrogant and greedy. Character inspiration: Mario Ferrati - Rififi (1995)

LAWYER (any gender, mid 40s)

A reserved solicitor, sincere and experienced - small but key opening and final scene supporting role with lines.

DETECTIVE INSPECTOR (any gender, mid-late 30s)

A stern, assertive and authoritative character - small but key final scene supporting role with lines.

CONSTABLE (any gender, late 20s)

A young and inexperienced character - small by key final scene supporting role with lines.

To apply:

Please send headshot, showreel (if available) and CV to grace.moore@york.ac.uk 

Please include the role name in the subject line of your email.

If possible, please also indicate your availability across the aforementioned filming dates, (w/c 31st August + w/c 7th September).

We’re casting the lead role in a contemplative arthouse style film. Runtime will be approx. 70 mins. Influences include Andrei Tarkovsky, David Lynch, Wong Kar-Wai

Please note this is an **UNPAID** volunteer-based role best suited for students looking to build or expand their showreel. The micro budget we have will all be put towards **transport**, **food** & **accommodation** for all cast & crew involved across all shoot days

**Dates & location:** most of the film will be filmed over 3 weeks on location in the Lake District around February 2027 (accommodation will be booked around actors’ schedules). A few extra scenes will be filmed in Leeds after the main filming block (no set timeframe)

**How to apply: **please film a short audition video and email to willjamesfletcher@gmail.com or DM me on Facebook - script excerpt below. Only the highlighted lines in the script are needed in the video, the rest is just included for context. Include headshots/showreel if you have them (but not essential)

Audition script:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xzj7825vrqpZFjxex1DNQSgG1U39Skpe/view?usp=sharing

items.text:
CASTING CALL – Black & Asian Children – Non-Speaking Product Video - Paid

I'm casting for a non-speaking product video featuring creative building toys similar to LEGO-style construction sets. Non-union.

I'm looking for the following roles:

Role 1 - Female, Age 4-7, Black

Role 2 - Male, Age 7–12, Black

Role 3 - Male, Age 4-7, Asian

Role 4 - Female, Age 7-12, Asian

Ideal Candidates
* Outgoing, confident personalities who enjoy playing with toys
* Able to follow simple direction and stay engaged during filming
* Comfortable in front of the camera
* Previous modeling or acting experience is welcome, but not required

Project Details
* Non-speaking role
* Small-scale, two-person production team in a relaxed, low-stress environment
* Each child will likely be needed for 1–2 hours, though filming may extend up to 4 hours

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150 per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks)

Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage

The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note

Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be released to the talent or used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement

A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?

Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com :
* Child's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability over the summer
* Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting Role # – (Age, Gender)

Example: Child Casting Role #4– 10, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150 per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks)

Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage

The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note

Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be released to the talent or used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement

A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?

Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com :
* Child's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability over the summer
* Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting Role # – (Age, Gender)

Example: Child Casting Role #4– 10, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

Professional Photoshoot Day with Arthur Hall

A great photo opens doors before you even say a word.

Whether you're applying for a new job, building your business, updating your acting portfolio or simply want photos you're proud to share, this is an opportunity to invest in yourself.

For one afternoon only, professional photographer Arthur Hall will be offering individual portrait sessions in Praga Południe. Every participant receives dedicated time to create images that feel natural, confident and authentic.

If the weather is on our side, we'll also explore nearby outdoor locations, creating unique portraits with natural light and the character of the neighborhood.

Perfect for

• Business & LinkedIn profiles
• CVs and professional profiles
• Acting headshots
• Modeling portfolios
• Personal branding
• Websites
• Social media
• Creative portraits

What's Included

• Individual professional photo session
• Guidance throughout the shoot
• Indoor and outdoor photo opportunities
• Professionally edited photos

Event Details

Date: Saturday, August 1

Location: Praga Południe, Warsaw (exact address shared after booking)

Price: Starting from 150 PLN with our Early Bird offer.

Session Duration: Each participant is allocated an individual 10–15 minute photoshoot.

Image Delivery

You will receive a private online gallery containing 3–5 professionally edited images within 3 working days after the event.

Participants who choose the Premium Package will receive their edited images on the same day, ready to use immediately.

Important – Appointment Required

After purchasing your ticket, you must reserve your photoshoot time slot using the link below:

https://calendar.app.google/dtyseTNxYPkn8E7G9

Your booking is confirmed only after completing both of the following steps:

Purchase your ticket.

Reserve your appointment time.

Time slots are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

About Arthur Hall

Arthur Hall is a portrait photographer specializing in personal branding, lifestyle and creative photography. His relaxed approach helps people feel comfortable in front of the camera, creating images that feel genuine, confident and timeless.

Instagram: @arthurhall.photography

About Impact Warsaw

Impact Warsaw brings locals and internationals together through creativity, culture and meaningful experiences.

From comedy shows and workshops to networking events and cultural experiences, our mission is simple: create spaces where people can meet, grow and discover new opportunities together.

Website: https://impactwarsaw.com

Instagram: @impactwarsaw

Inner Circle: https://t.me/+xJpuxiG5Au8xMmZk

Support our mission: https://buymeacoffee.com/impactwarsaw

CAST & CREW WANTED – HELP! 

AYKAY GP TV - In Partnership With Byron JJeffect Highton, is looking for passionate people to help bring our upcoming horror feature HELP! to life.

We're currently searching for:

 Actors & Supporting Artists (Ages 16+)

 Camera Crew

 Sound Recordists

 Lighting Assistants

 Production Assistants

 Makeup & SFX Artists

 BTS Photographers

 Filming Locations

 Anyone who wants to be part of an exciting independent horror production.

This is a voluntary, no-budget project based around Preston, Lancashire, giving everyone the chance to gain experience, build their portfolio, and be part of something ambitious.

Casting Call: Actors, Interactive Performers & Scare Technicians

Gallows Hill Museum & Theatre – Salem, Massachusetts / The Lost Museum Haunted Adventure

Paid Seasonal Positions
Fall Halloween Season

Gallows Hill Museum & Theatre, one of Salem’s premier Halloween attractions, is seeking talented, energetic, and dependable performers to join our cast for the upcoming fall season. We are casting for multiple short productions that blend theatrical storytelling, audience interaction, suspense, and practical effects.

Production 1: Main Stage Immersive Experience

We’re seeking versatile actors to perform in our signature immersive theatrical production about witches and ghosts.

This fast-paced 22 minute show features a single performer portraying multiple characters through rapid costume changes, dynamic storytelling, comedy, suspense, and the use of puppetry. Performers must be comfortable switching between distinct personalities while maintaining high energy throughout each performance.

Ideal candidates possess:

Strong acting and storytelling abilities
Excellent character work
Confidence performing for live audiences
Quick memorization skills
High energy
Some experience with improvisation

This role offers an exciting opportunity to showcase versatility in a truly unique theatrical experience.

Production 2: The Lost Museum

Step into the role of an eccentric museum guide as guests explore a collection of mysterious artifacts and strange curiosities…

…until everything begins to go spectacularly wrong.

Actors portraying museum guides lead guests through haunted rooms while balancing suspense, audience interaction, and improvisation. You’ll remain in character as supernatural events unfold around your tour group, creating an experience that is equal parts entertaining, immersive, and delightfully chaotic. 

When not leading tours, performers will also work as Scare Technicians, operating puppets, ghosts, practical effects, lighting cues, hidden scares, and other theatrical illusions that make the attraction come alive.

We’re seeking performers who are:

Passionate about theatre, Halloween, and immersive entertainment
Strong communicators comfortable speaking to groups
Excellent improvisers who can think on their feet
Reliable, punctual, and professional
Team players with positive attitudes
Comfortable interacting with audiences of all ages
Interested in learning backstage theatrical effects and puppet operation
Day, evening and weekend shifts are available.

Previous experience in theatre, haunted attractions, improv, museums, escape rooms, theme parks, or live entertainment is welcomed but not required. We are happy to train enthusiastic individuals with a strong work ethic and a willingness to learn.

Please submit:

Headshot (professional or recent clear photo)
Resume (if available)
A brief introduction telling us about yourself and why you’d like to join our cast
Demo reel (optional)
Video submission is also acceptable

 Email: gallowshillsalem@outlook.com for an audition appointment.

CASTING CALL – Non-Union Table Read

Rakshas Drishti (Proof of Concept Short Film)

Trilokam Entertainment is seeking performers for a live Zoom table read of Rakshas Drishti, an original horror mythology proof-of-concept set in modern-day Texas.

We're looking for enthusiastic actors who enjoy character-driven storytelling inspired by Hindu mythology. Whether you're experienced or just beginning your acting journey, we'd love to hear from you.

Table Read Details • Wednesday, July 29, 2026

• 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Pacific)

• Conducted via Zoom

About the Project A Hindu priest living in Texas is granted the divine ability to see humanity's six inner vices as terrifying Rakshasas. As these ancient forces begin to gather, he must uncover the truth before darkness consumes the world.

We're Looking For • Supporting roles only

• Performers of all ethnicities welcome

• All experience levels encouraged to apply

The table read is unpaid and is intended to help develop the proof of concept. Acting roles in the filmed production will be paid.

To Submit Email: trilokamcasting@gmail.com

Please include: • Headshot (required)

• Resume (if available)

• Contact information

• A brief summary of any acting or performance experience (optional)

We look forward to meeting passionate performers interested in helping bring an original mythology-inspired horror story to life.

Für ein langfristig angelegtes Projekt suchen wir eine motivierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns eine professionelle und authentische TikTok-Personal-Brand aufbaut.

Das erwartet dich

✔ Aufbau einer eigenen Personal Brand

✔ Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team

✔ Arbeit mit einem bereits bestehenden, marktreifen Produkt

✔ Persönliche Einarbeitung und Begleitung

✔ Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Projekts

Das solltest du mitbringen

✔ Zuverlässigkeit und Motivation

✔ Freude an Social Media und Kommunikation

✔ Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen

✔ Ein sympathisches und authentisches Auftreten

Vorkenntnisse oder eine grosse Reichweite sind keine Voraussetzung.

Transparenz ist uns wichtig

items.text:
# Wir suchen mehrere Gesichter für TikTok-Personal-Brands

Für bereits bestehende und marktreife Produkte suchen wir **mehrere sympathische, kommunikative und zuverlässige Personen**, die gemeinsam mit uns langfristig eigene TikTok-Personal-Brands aufbauen möchten.

# **Deine Aufgaben**
* Regelmässige Aufnahme von TikTok-Videos und weiterem Short-Form-Content
* Umsetzung von vorgegebenen Skripten, Briefings und Content-Ideen
* Authentische Präsentation und Bewerbung eines bestehenden Produktes
* Aufbau einer glaubwürdigen und langfristigen Personal Brand
* Zuverlässige und kontinuierliche Content-Produktion
* Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung der Inhalte

# Das solltest du mitbringen
* Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
* Du kannst Inhalte sympathisch, natürlich und überzeugend vermitteln
* Du arbeitest zuverlässig und hältst dich an Absprachen
* Du bist offen für Feedback und kannst Vorgaben professionell umsetzen
* Du hast Interesse an Social Media, Content-Produktion und Personal Branding
* Du möchtest langfristig mit einem festen Team zusammenarbeiten
* Eine bereits vorhandene Reichweite ist nicht erforderlich

# Was dich erwartet
* Klare Skripte, Briefings und Unterstützung durch unser Team
* Eine langfristig angelegte Zusammenarbeit
* Der Aufbau eines eigenen Social-Media-Auftritts
* Die Bewerbung eines bereits bestehenden und marktreifen Produktes
* Klare Prozesse und eine enge Zusammenarbeit bei der Content-Planung
* Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung mit prozentualer Beteiligung an den durch deinen Content generierten Leads Partenaire.

## Wir möchten **mehrere TikTok-Personal-Brands parallel aufbauen** und freuen uns deshalb über Bewerbungen von unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten.

## Bei Interesse sende uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Standort und ein kurzes Handyvideo, in dem du dich vorstellst. Vorhandene Social-Media-Profile oder Referenzen kannst du gerne ebenfalls mitschicken.

Une information extraite du journal du SFA sur la suppression du cumul emploi retraite intégral jusqu’à 67 ans même pour celles et ceux qui prennent leur retraite à taux plein ! C’est à compter du 1er janvier 2027.

items.text:
**CASTING CALL** — Lead Singer’s Mum (Music Video: We Know About You)

We’re looking for a white female aged 26–35, based near Chorley, Lancashire, to play the role of the Lead Singer’s Mum in a series of memory-driven scenes for an upcoming music video, We Know About You.

You can find out more about the band - **MBL **- on their Facebook page - https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61574053419607

**About the Role**

This character appears across several playful, surreal, and emotional memory moments. You’ll feature in:

• **Cabaret stage scenes **— dancing/posing in a cabaret outfit with feathers (no nudity, just subtle nods and playful confidence).

• **Club moments** — fun, cheeky interactions in a lively cabaret-style environment.

• **Hide-and-seek in the woods** — with a 6-year-old child (playing your son) and a teenage version of him.

• **Gardening in cabaret costume **— a surreal, humorous visual beat.

**Details**

• Role: Lead Singer’s Mum (Memory Sequences)

• Age Range: 26–35

• Ethnicity: White

• Location: Eccleston / Chorley

• Film Dates: 25th & 26th August

• Payment: Paid role

• Expenses: Travel covered

• Dialogue: None

• Costume: Provided

• Experience: No formal dance or acting experience needed

• Vibe: Fun, confident, expressive, comfortable in cabaret styling

**To Apply**

Send your name, location, and availability, plus a recent photo or showreel if you have one, to ***info@doublesixproductions.com***. We’re looking for someone with confidence, personality, and playful energy.
items.previewDescription: MBL were a Manchester band during the 90's. Our sound was varied, but you could loosely say we were a "Indie Guitar Band" We played across the UK and were also known for our sticker and poster campaigns

Hi all!  Here's a job opp for anyone in the group who is free for a few hours on July 30th, in the 40+ age range, and want to make some quick money - 

**CASTING CALL: Actors/Servers Needed for July 30th Event**

I’m seeking **five experienced servers** for a low-budget, filmed dinner event at a restaurant location in Simi Valley on July 30th. 

This is a great opportunity for either:
* experienced event servers who are comfortable on camera OR 
* performance-forward actors who are also comfortable serving

**Date:** Thursday, July 30

**Time:** 5:00 PM – 9:30 / 10:00 PM

**Location:** Simi Valley, CA

**Age:** 40+ older

**Pay**: $250

**Responsibilities will include:**
* Serving plated food from the restaurant
* Refilling beverages
* Reciting and explaining the dinner menu
* Providing polished, attentive tableside service
* Participating in an elevated, fine-dining-style experience

The event will be attended by content creators and filmed throughout the evening on guests’ phones. All staff must be comfortable appearing on camera and potentially being featured in social content.

Extra kudos for anyone who can sing, dance, improvise, act, or confidently engage with guests on camera.

**Required attire:** White button-down shirt, black dress pants, black dress shoes, and black tie.

If interested, please shoot me a DM or email [hbudnik23@gmail.com](mailto:hbudnik23@gmail.com) and provide:

A short bio 

Performance samples or website/social links

Za każdą wyjątkową restauracją stoi wyjątkowy człowiek…
Szukamy restauratorów z całej Polski do nowego programu TV! 📺🍽️

Bo najlepsze jedzenie to dopiero początek…

Chcemy poznać ludzi, którzy stworzyli niesamowite miejsca z prawdziwą duszą. Restauracje, w których liczy się nie tylko to, co trafia na talerz, ale też historia, emocje, atmosfera i ludzie, którzy ją tworzą. ❤️

Szukamy wyjątkowych miejsc:

✨ restauracji z charakterem i niepowtarzalnym klimatem

✨ rodzinnych biznesów tworzonych z sercem

✨ kulinarnych perełek ukrytych w całej Polsce

✨ lokali, które mają swoją historię 

✨ właścicieli, dla których gotowanie i goszczenie ludzi to prawdziwa pasja

Czy goście przychodzą do Was nie tylko dla jedzenia, ale też dla atmosfery, którą stworzyliście?

Czy za Waszym miejscem stoi historia, którą warto opowiedzieć całej Polsce?

📩 Napisz do nas zgloszenia@rochstar.tv - w załączniku dodaj krótką wideowizytowkę i opis Twojej restauracji :)

🎬 POSZUKUJEMY STATYSTÓW DO FILMU KOSTIUMOWEGO! Ekranizacja  znanej powiesci

Warszawa i okolice

Do filmu kostiumowego, którego akcja rozgrywa się w XIX wieku oraz na początku XX wieku, poszukujemy statystów.
📅 Terminy zdjęć:
11.08
13.08
Część osób zostanie wybrana do udziału w obu dniach zdjęciowych (kontynuacja), a część tylko na jeden z podanych terminów.
👔 Przymiarki kostiumów:
6.08
7.08
10.08

Poszukujemy osób do ról:
Mieszczanie
Typ pracowniczy
Żydzi

💰 Stawki:
120 zł – udział w jednym dniu zdjęciowym
180 zł – udział w dwóch dniach zdjęciowych (kontynuacja)
50 zł – przymiarka kostiumu
Płatność: gotówką.

Wymagania: Poszukujemy wyłącznie osób o naturalnym wyglądzie:
bez zabiegów medycyny estetycznej,
bez makijażu permanentnego brwi,
bez hybryd i pomalowanych paznokci,
bez tatuaży w widocznych miejscach,
bez włosów strzyżonych maszynką oraz bez współczesnych fryzur.

📧 Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na adres: agencjasceneria.magda@gmail.com

Tytuł wiadomości: BB 113

W treści zgłoszenia prosimy podać:
aktualne zdjęcia twarzy oraz sylwetki (bez makijażu), Panowie - zdjecie boku I tyl fryzury. Panie zdjecie w rozpuszczonych wlosach
imię i nazwisko,
wiek,
informację o posiadanych tatuażach,
numer telefonu.

ZZapraszay

**Termin:** 09:00 bis ca. 14:00 Uhr inkl. Pause
**Drehort:** TSV Herrsching e. V., Jahnstraße 14, 82211 Herrsching am Ammersee

Ideal wäre, wenn du aus der Umgebung kommst oder keine allzu weite Anreise hast.

items.text:
CASTING CALL

We're looking for two performers to join our DICK WHITTINGTON pantomime (school tour).  
Running from 30th November - 18th December 2026 + some January dates TBC.

We’re casting any of the following parts, with our existing performers playing the opposite roles. All ages and ethnicities welcome to apply.

- Dick Whittington (lead,  M or F)
- Tiddles the Cat (comic,  M or F)
- Mayor Dratt  (villain,  M only)
- Alice Fitzwarren (love interest,  F only)

Because we perform in schools, the shows are weekday mornings and early afternoons, so you'll have your evenings and weekends free. The performances are in the Norfolk, Suffolk and Cambridge area. 

We’re currently offering a minimum of £1050 - which will go up as we get more bookings in + travel expenses. 
Aiming to start a mix of Wednesday & Thursday weekly rehearsals from September - in HUNSTANTON (PE36).
Whilst rehearsals are unpaid,  any unused travel expenses from the tour will be shared amongst the cast at the end. 

This will be our fourteenth panto tour, and we've built up a good name in the area, with schools booking us year after year (even before we announce the title!) We pride ourselves on being a warm, friendly, but professional company.

If interested, please get in touch for further details - either by a PM on here, or via email - purple-dreams@hotmail.co.uk - I’m looking forward to hearing from (some) of you. 🙂

Many thanks
Tobias Nicholls
Creative Director 
Purple Dreams Productions

Non-Union, Paid Role:
*Canadian Male 40s-50s years old to play Dracula

Must be able present and speak as Dracula, with the accent, for up to 30 minutes in front of a live audience.

Paid role, but the budget is still being finalized, so will update as soon as possible.

Talent must work as local in Québec City.

If interested and available, please submit CURRENT headshot, full body photo and a self-tape audition to amylimcasting@gmail.com.  Submissions due by 7/19 at 9pm.

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 31/2026

FILMMUSIK IN PAASDORF UND SPIDER-MAN NÄCHSTER AUFTRITT.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day ist der offizielle Titel des vierten MCU-Spider-Man-Films mit Tom Kinos anläuft. Der von Sony Pictures und den Marvel Studios produzierte Blockbuster setzt vier Jahre nach den Ereignissen von Spider-Man: No Way Home an und zeigt einen erwachsenen, völlig isolierten Peter Parker. 

The Stories“ ist ein internationaler Spielfilm  unter der Regie des österreichisch-ägyptischen Regisseurs Abu Bakr Shawky. Es handelt sich um ein herzerwärmendes, semi-autobiografisches Drama, das auf der wahren Liebesgeschichte seiner eigenen Eltern basiert. Mit dem Regisseur konnte Sarah Fuchs ein paar Worte wechseln. 

Das Open-Air-Filmmusikkonzert „Magic Movie Moments“  in Paasdorf fand  27. Juni 2026, am Paasdorfer Kellerrundplatz statt. Unsere Moderatorin konnte bei diesem Event ein paar Stimmen einfangen.

Sam Neill (Jurassic Park) starb vor wenigen Tagen im Alter von 78. Ihm zum Gedenken spielen wir die Musik aus seinen bekanntesten Filmen.

Mittwoch 29.7.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

items.text:
Do sierpniowego odcinka serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

1. Kamil (24) – agresywny socjopata i patologiczny kłamca z przeszłością w poprawczaku, mocno zadłużony. Silny, na dopalaczach, bezwzględne spojrzenie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY 
Daty: 10.08 i 11.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

2. Adrian (27) – Interesuje się strzelectwem, jest instruktorem na strzelnicy. Zostaje postrzelony przez kolegę, gdy próbuje obezwładnić go podczas włamania.
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

3. Dominik (28) – prowadzi spółkę zajmującą się kompleksowym montażem nowoczesnych instalacji elektrycznych, alarmów i monitoringu. Zostaje pobity. Średniej budowy ciała, nie jest silny fizycznie. 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4. Pracownik 2 (28) – pracownik budowlany
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

5. Sebastian (30) – prowadzi komis, karany w przeszłości za kradzieże. Skupuje kradziony sprzęt.
Data: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

6. Pracownik 1 (37) – pracownik budowlany 
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 11.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

7. Konrad (39) – brat Artura. Nieporadny, z bardzo niską samooceną, wiecznie gnębiony przez brata i niedoceniany przez rodziców. Przez całe życie gromadził w sobie żal i gniew. Wysoki, szczupły, dłuższe włosy.
KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Daty: 12.08 i 14.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

8. Biznesmen (45) – elegancko ubrany mężczyzna, zostaje napadnięty na ulicy. 
Daty: 10.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9. Właściciel (48) – przedsiębiorca budowlany. Zawiadamia policję o zaginięciu pracowników i pomaga w identyfikacji. 
Daty: 11.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
Ruszamy z wakacyjnymi warsztatami aktorskimi OPEN, otwartymi dla każdego, kto chce spróbować swoich sił na scenie, rozwinąć nowe umiejętności lub po prostu przeżyć sierpień pełny inspirujących spotkań.
▪️◾️▪️

W sierpniu spotkasz się z różnymi prowadzącymi, którzy są zawodowymi aktorami, pokażą Wam różne podejścia do pracy aktora:

✨ praca z głosem i dykcją
✨ świadomość ciała i ruch sceniczny
✨ improwizacja
✨ praca z emocjami
✨ odwaga sceniczna i wystąpienia publiczne

▪️◾️▪️
To propozycja dla osób, które:

▪️ marzą o aktorstwie i chcą sprawdzić, czy scena jest dla nich,
▪️ chcą mówić pewniej i swobodniej występować przed ludźmi,
▪️ potrzebują więcej odwagi i pewności siebie,
▪️ chcą lepiej poznać możliwości swojego ciała i głosu,
▪️ szukają kreatywnego sposobu na spędzenie wakacji,
▪️ chcą poznać nowych, ciekawych ludzi.

▪️◾️▪️
Bez egzaminów. Bez presji. Za to z dużą dawką praktyki, dobrej energii i teatralnych doświadczeń.

Jeśli od dawna chodzi Ci po głowie myśl: „A może by tak spróbować?” – wakacje są idealnym momentem, żeby zrobić pierwszy krok. 

Dołącz do nas 🔥

Fot. Maciej Kempiński

items.text:
PROJECT INDIA
Lokacja zdjęć: Warszawa 

 Ilość dni zdjęciowych: 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe (w zależności od roli) - 18-19 sierpnia 🎬🎥✅

 Prawa / Usage Rights: 1 rok 

 Terytorium emisji: INDIE (Brak emisji w Polsce / Europie / UK)

 Pola eksploatacji: TV, Digital, Internet, Social Media

ROLE GŁÓWNE (HERO ROLES) — 1 000 USD / dzień z prawami 

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. REŻYSER (THE DIRECTOR) — 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 40–60 lat (typ indyjsko-brytyjski lub europejski).

 Opis: Prawdziwy twórca kinowy, lekko niewyspany, charakterystyczny.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego, wyczucie aktorskie)

2. NARZECZONY (ROMANTIC LEAD) [Gra mimiką]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Charyzmatyczny, ciepły, bardzo męski, dojrzały urok.

 Wymagania: Świetna gra emocjami i mimiką.

KATEGORIA 2: ROLE DRUGOPLANOWE  — 700 USD / dzień z prawami

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. 1st AD (1-szy Asystent Reżysera) 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–45 lat.

 Opis: Dynamiczny, głośny, ekspresyjny. Komediowy wykrzyk "CUT!". 

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

2. OPERATOR (CAMERAMAN) —

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–50 lat.

 Opis: Członek ekipy filmowej z krótką kwestią.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

3. OFIARA (VICTIM) — Scena Zombie [Gra ekspresyjna]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Bohater sceny z zombie. Świetny warsztat komediowo-dramatyczny (krzyk, przerażenie, zmiana emocji na zdziwienie).

4.HERO ZOMBIE [Praca ciałem / Plastyka]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Główny zombie. Bardzo wysoka sprawność fizyczna, doskonała plastyka ciała i ekspresja ruchu.

👥 KATEGORIA 3: Mini EPISODES & BG CREW/Extras  — 200 USD / dzień

(Możliwy 1 -2 dzień zdjęciowy lub krótka sesja skanowania 3D)

1. ZAŁOGA PUSTYNI / MAD MAX CREW (3 osoby)

 Wiek / Płeć: 1 Kobieta, 2 Mężczyzn (25–40 lat).

 Opis: Stylistyka Mad Max / Dune. Ostre, surowe, charakterne rysy twarzy.

2. ZAŁOGA KOSMICZNA (BRIDGE CREW )

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Elegancja, chłodny dystyngowany wygląd.

3. EKIPA TECHNICZNA  (Producent, Focus Puller, Charakteryzator itp.)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–50 lat.

 Opis: Aktorzy / epizodyści potrafiący grać w stylu deadpan (bezemocjonalna, obojętna reakcja na chaos wokół).

4. ZOMBIE EXTRAS (4–6 osób)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Statyści sceny zombie. Wymagana dobra sprawność fizyczna, swoboda w pracy z profesjonalną charakteryzacją oraz ekspresyjna gra ciałem/ruchem.

Część epizodystów/extras z grup (np. załoga statku, technicy) nie będzie obecna na planie przez cały czas. Zostaną oni jedynie odskanowani w 3D, a ich wizerunek zostanie zintegrowany z wideo przy użyciu Sztucznej Inteligencji (AI) wyłącznie na potrzeby tego konkretnego spotu reklamowego.

Wszyscy kandydaci muszą wyrazić pisemną zgodę na skanowanie 3D oraz wykorzystanie ich wizerunku w AI (wyłącznie dla tego projektu).

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA / JAK APLIKOWAĆ:

Prosimy o nadsyłanie zgłoszeń na adres: tatianamakhdi@gmail.com

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: PROJECT INDIA - [NAZWA ROLI] - [IMIĘ I NAZWISKO]

Wymagane materiały:

1. Aktualne zdjęcia: Twarz + Sylwetka

2. Wymiary / Wzrost.

3. Wizytówka wideo po angielsku (obowiązkowo dla ról z kwestiami mówionymi: Director, 1st AD, Cameraman, Producer i td.)

4.telefon

**POSZUKIWANI STATYŚCI NA PLAN**

Do filmu dyplomowego studentki Warszawskiej Szkoły Filmowej poszukujemy kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku** 40-65 lat**.

📅 Termin: **4-5 sierpnia** (udział w jednym z dni, data do ustalenia)

📍 Miejsce: **Warszawa**

Ze względu na to, że jest to projekt studencki, udział jest **non-profit**, natomiast zapewniamy transport, wyżywienie na planie oraz miłą atmosferę.

Kilka słów o twórcach:

Poprzedni film reżyserki Agaty Kapuścińskiej i autora zdjęć Mateusza Gzela —„Nibylandex” — był prezentowany m.in. na Krakowskim Festiwalu Filmowym, Festiwalu Polskich Filmów Fabularnych w Gdyni oraz EnergaCAMERIMAGE, a także na trzech festiwalach kwalifikujących do Oscara. Wierzymy, że „Futuria” również ma szansę dotrzeć do szerokiej publiczności i odnieść podobny sukces.

📩 Jeśli chcesz wziąć udział lub znasz kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany – napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej. Będzie nam bardzo miło, jeśli dołączysz do naszej ekipy!

Serdeczne pozdrowienia,

Ekipa filmu ,,FUTURIA”

PROJECT INDIA
Lokacja zdjęć: Warszawa 

 Ilość dni zdjęciowych: 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe (w zależności od roli) - 18-19 sierpnia 🎬🎥✅

 Prawa / Usage Rights: 1 rok 

 Terytorium emisji: INDIE (Brak emisji w Polsce / Europie / UK)

 Pola eksploatacji: TV, Digital, Internet, Social Media

ROLE GŁÓWNE (HERO ROLES) — 1 000 USD / dzień z prawami 

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. REŻYSER (THE DIRECTOR) — 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 40–60 lat (typ indyjsko-brytyjski lub europejski).

 Opis: Prawdziwy twórca kinowy, lekko niewyspany, charakterystyczny.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego, wyczucie aktorskie)

2. NARZECZONY (ROMANTIC LEAD) [Gra mimiką]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Charyzmatyczny, ciepły, bardzo męski, dojrzały urok.

 Wymagania: Świetna gra emocjami i mimiką.

KATEGORIA 2: ROLE DRUGOPLANOWE  — 700 USD / dzień z prawami

(Możliwy 1 lub 2 dni zdjęciowe)

1. 1st AD (1-szy Asystent Reżysera) 

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–45 lat.

 Opis: Dynamiczny, głośny, ekspresyjny. Komediowy wykrzyk "CUT!". 

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

2. OPERATOR (CAMERAMAN) —

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–50 lat.

 Opis: Członek ekipy filmowej z krótką kwestią.

 Wymagania: Możliwe kilka fraz po angielsku – wymagana znajomość języka angielskiego.

3. OFIARA (VICTIM) — Scena Zombie [Gra ekspresyjna]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 30–40 lat.

 Opis: Bohater sceny z zombie. Świetny warsztat komediowo-dramatyczny (krzyk, przerażenie, zmiana emocji na zdziwienie).

4.HERO ZOMBIE [Praca ciałem / Plastyka]

 Wiek / Płeć: Mężczyzna, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Główny zombie. Bardzo wysoka sprawność fizyczna, doskonała plastyka ciała i ekspresja ruchu.

👥 KATEGORIA 3: Mini EPISODES & BG CREW/Extras  — 200 USD / dzień

(Możliwy 1 -2 dzień zdjęciowy lub krótka sesja skanowania 3D)

1. ZAŁOGA PUSTYNI / MAD MAX CREW (3 osoby)

 Wiek / Płeć: 1 Kobieta, 2 Mężczyzn (25–40 lat).

 Opis: Stylistyka Mad Max / Dune. Ostre, surowe, charakterne rysy twarzy.

2. ZAŁOGA KOSMICZNA (BRIDGE CREW )

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Elegancja, chłodny dystyngowany wygląd.

3. EKIPA TECHNICZNA  (Producent, Focus Puller, Charakteryzator itp.)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–50 lat.

 Opis: Aktorzy / epizodyści potrafiący grać w stylu deadpan (bezemocjonalna, obojętna reakcja na chaos wokół).

4. ZOMBIE EXTRAS (4–6 osób)

 Wiek / Płeć: Kobiety i Mężczyźni, 25–40 lat.

 Opis: Statyści sceny zombie. Wymagana dobra sprawność fizyczna, swoboda w pracy z profesjonalną charakteryzacją oraz ekspresyjna gra ciałem/ruchem.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL – “Forever, Summer” (Volunteer Short Film)

Hey everyone! ❤️

I’m so excited to share that we’ve officially started casting for my passion project, Forever, Summer, a romantic drama short film that will be filmed in Metro Vancouver this September.

We’re currently casting:

🎭 Hunter (Lead)
• Playing age: 23 (Actors 19+)
• Open to all ethnicities

🎭 Ryan (Supporting)
• Playing age: 27 (Actors 23+)
• White or Hispanic preferred, with dark hair and dark eyes to reflect a believable family resemblance.

📍 Must be able to work locally in Metro Vancouver.
📅 Must be available between September 4–7, 2026.

This is a volunteer project, and all cast members will receive:
• IMDb credit
• Professional footage for their demo reel
• Meals on set
• An invitation to attend film festival screenings if the film is officially selected

To submit, please email which character do you want to audition, your headshot, resume and demo reel (if you have one) to foreversummer.casting@gmail.com  by August 9. Selected actors will receive audition sides.

Thank you so much!!

*PAID* Casting Call for Les Immigrants - The Party

"Girls, Insecure, Sex and the City, but more raw, more real"

Short-film Logline: A romantic dramedy exploring modern dating, identity and self-worth, seen from the eyes of an immigrant woman navigating a chaotic night that shifts from illusion to reality.

CASTING FOR ONE MORE ACTOR! PAID ROLE

Juan. Age range: 30's, male, Latin/Mexican ethnicity, with a Spanish accent

Juan is charismatic, confident, impulsive, and impossible to ignore.bHe moves through the world with ease, charm, and a reckless sense of freedom, but beneath his playful exterior is a man who avoids vulnerability.

Note: Actor must be comfortable performing intimacy on camera, kissing scenes.

SUBMISSIONS & AUDITION DETAILS

Please send your resume, photos (full body + headshots) and demo reel (if available) by email to lesimmigrantsparty@gmail.com ASAP

Auditions in Gastown this Saturday, August 1st!!!

SHOOT DETAILS

Type of project: Dramatic short film

Production Company: Ashtrey Productions

Director: Titus Heckel

Producer, casting: Ronald Lee

Location: Vancouver, BC

Shoot Dates: August 21st-23rd, 2026, rehearsals prior

Shoot Length: 1 to 3 Days

Compensation: Paid/TBD/Indie Micro-Budget, IMDb Credit, meals provided

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email your headshot, resume and demo reel (if available) to lesimmigrantsparty@gmail.com

We're casting for **These Little Moments**, a heartfelt coming-of-age drama set in 2002 about four childhood friends reuniting for one final summer road trip before tragedy changes everything.

We're looking for actors **playing ages 20–27** for four lead roles:

**JAMES (20–27)**
The geeky guy who overthinks every move he makes. He has had a secret crush on Emma for ages but never quite had the guts to ask her out, always telling himself he could wait for the right moment. Over the course of the trip, he learns that the right moment doesn't always come, and that if he truly cares about something, he has to act.

**RUBY (20–27)**
The caring leader and enthusiastic glue of the group. She has always loved living in their small town and never questioned it, but lately, watching her friends leave one by one, she has started to doubt the choices she made. Underneath the big energy is someone quietly afraid of being the one left behind.

**EMMA (20–27)**
An optimistic girl who hides her fears behind a smile. She left their hometown young to study fashion, and she still wavers between chasing her dreams and the pull of the life she left behind. Now she has a once-in-a-lifetime chance in front of her, but her own dark thoughts hold her back and leave her yearning for somewhere that feels safe.

**ELIO (20–27)**
The lovable stoner who doesn't have big dreams and is perfectly fine with that. He loves music and looks forward to a simple life running a small CD shop. His laid-back demeanour makes people think he doesn't care, but beneath it, he is devoted to his friends, filming every moment of the holiday because he can't imagine life without them.

 **Shooting:** Germany (Berlin/Brandenburg)
 **Dates:** 8–17 September 2026
 **Language:** English

If you're interested, please send your **CV/showreel**, a **short introduction**, which **character you'd like to play**, and **why the project intrigued you** to:

**crasherscollective@gmail.com**

Feel free to share this post with anyone who might be a great fit—we can't wait to hear from you!

++ 🔥Wenn der Metal die Hölle entfesselt... 🔥++

Ab August 2027 entsteht auf dem Gelände des Rock the Farm Langerringen  Festivals eine Horrorcomedy, die das Metal-Genre auf den Kopf stellen könnte.

Was passiert, wenn ein friedliches Heavy-Metal-Festival plötzlich zum Epizentrum einer Dämoneninvasion wird?

Genau diese Frage soll ab August 2027 auf dem legendären ROCK THE FARM-Gelände in Langerringen beantwortet werden – dort, wo jedes Jahr echte Metalheads gemeinsam feiern, soll schon bald das Grauen Einzug halten. 

Doch keine Sorge: Zwischen blutigen Monstern, höllischen Kreaturen und dem drohenden Weltuntergang bleibt reichlich Platz für rabenschwarzen Humor, absurde Situationen und jede Menge Heavy Metal.

Stellt euch vor:

Ein Festival. Hunderte Metalfans. Gitarren. Schlagzeug. Bier. Moshpits. Die lautesten Bands des Abends...

...und plötzlich öffnet sich mitten auf dem Gelände ein Tor zur Hölle.

Während Dämonen das Festival übernehmen und Chaos ausbricht, müssen ausgerechnet Musiker, Crew-Mitglieder und Besucher zusammenhalten. Denn wer glaubt, dass nur Weihwasser gegen das Böse hilft, kennt die Macht einer voll aufgedrehten Metalmeute noch nicht...

Die Macher sprechen von einer Liebeserklärung an die Metal-Szene. Wer Festivals kennt, wird unzählige Anspielungen entdecken. Wer Horror liebt, darf sich auf dämonische Kreaturen, übernatürliche Eskalationen und spektakuläre Effekte freuen. 

Und wer schwarzen Humor mag, könnte hier seinen neuen Kultfilm finden.

Eines steht jedoch schon jetzt fest:

Ab August 2027 wird auf dem ROCK THE FARM-Gelände nicht nur Metal gespielt - dort wird die Hölle ihre Tore öffnen, die Verstärker werden beben und die Nacht wird blutrot.

Vielleicht beginnt genau hier der lauteste, verrückteste und durchgeknallteste Horrorfilm, den die deutsche Metal-Szene jemals gesehen hat.

Und mit im aktuellen Team sind Menschen, die unter andrem bei folgenden Projekten vor und/oder hinter der Kamera standen: 

- LEVIZIA 
- ⁠START YOUNG 
- ⁠THE LAST TRAIN 
- ⁠DARK DAYZ 
- ⁠VHS: UNDERGROUND 1+2
- ⁠PUPPENMACHER
- ⁠WRONGFUL DEATH 
- ⁠ONG BAK 
- ⁠STREETFIGHTER: CHUN LI  
- ⁠BELLY OF THE BEAST 
- ⁠BIG GAME - DIE JAGD BEGINNT 
- ⁠DAS MEDDAILLON (mit Jackie Chan)
- ⁠MATRIX 4 (!!!) 

Und wenn du Teil davon sein willst: 

Wir suchen noch: 

👉 Metal-Statisten 

👉 Leute mit Erfahrung im Bereich Special Effects

👉 Leute, die uns hinter der Kamera aushelfen 

👉Co-Producer (inkl. rechtsgültigem Vertrag), die Teil des Projekts sein wollen!

🔥Stay tuned. Denn das ist erst der Anfang… 🔥

@Follower 
Erik Markus Schuetz Jean Rises elina.mj Christian Matthesius Sprachrohr Eisregen #Inanis KveldulF Spanky Ham 

#heavymetal #comedy #movie #Splatter #Horror #fun #specialeffects #festival

NOW CASTING
Looking for a male actor in the 30-40s age range who can do funny comedic and improv style acting who could play the role of a “gay best friend” for a short fun scene for a indie film.

NO PAY but all actors will receive IMDB and screen credit. Filming in the Los Angeles area.

Synopsis of the film: “Unforgettable” is a story about hope, courage and the determination of one woman’s journey of the impossible. Through this true story, we learn how one-woman refusal to give up a dream would allow her to receive unusual confirmations from beyond and how a loving song showed her signs of hope along the way. A true story of synchronicity and love between a grandfather and a very special song.

Please DM me if you’re interested. This is filming in August 2026.

Be good at something besides acting be passionate about other things too…

2 days after winning his first Oscar at 31:

Conga time!  #congas #percussion #marlonbrando #Brando #actors

https://youtu.be/ZkF2-ZZSx6k?feature=shared

Trivia:  Marlon Brando

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Although he received four patents prior to his death in 2004, Brando likely needed to put in more work to make his creation a reality; one drum manufacturer interviewed for a 2011 NPR article indicated that the actor’s design was practical, but not cost-effective enough for production.

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Hello everyone, my name is B Fernandes “Yuri”. I am urgently looking for an Actor to play "Danny",  
 (Male, late 20s–30s) — SUPPORTING
Energetic, talkative, socially expressive.
Provides early contrast before tension escalates.

     Must transition convincingly from light/comedic -- panic -- survival mode
Important for rhythm and realism.. foor my upcoming project, " BLUNDER" — a psychological thriller and drama. Filming will take place on 8 and 9 August, with a rehearsal scheduled for 1 August. While the rehearsal is less urgent, the shoot dates of 8 and 9 August are fixed and critical. This is a non‑budget production.
 
Please get in touch to learn more details and discuss the role.
 
About Blunder:
What starts as an ordinary birthday gathering soon spirals into a psychological trap when a mysterious package arrives at the wrong door. As the night unfolds, trust unravels, hidden intentions emerge, and what seemed like a controlled situation begins to shift. Events that appear accidental may have been deliberate all along — setting off an irreversible chain of consequences.

Email me on:
Bfernandes12@hotmail.com 
WhatsApp: 07759949810

**CHAPMAN UNIVERSITY CASTING CALL**

Title: The Sister

Logline: When a group of teenage girls engage in a series of pranks, one prank phone call threatens to expose the casual cruelty of girlhood. 

Shooting Date: Sunday, August 2nd

Hours: 10AM-4PM

Location: Orange ,CA

E-mail: moraleslopez@chapman.edu

Compensation: copy of film and credit are provided

JESSICA (15, LATINA)

 •A teen girl who’s an agitator through and through. She’s always ready to escalate a joke, even if it’s at the cost of someone else’s feelings. To her, empathy is laughable, and she feels the burning need to be the center of attention. 

KAYLA (16, LATINA)

   •The group's enabler. Often lacking her own opinion, Kayla sticks to whoever she views as the leader in any situation. She does as she's told out of fear of being viewed as different, even if her actions carry out hurtful consequences. 

No minors. Looking for actresses between the ages of 18-25. 

Feel free to email a headshot and reel to moraleslopez@chapman.edu

items.text:
I am looking for a talented, Las Vegas-based videographer and editor for a long-term creative partnership to help scale the brand for my new startup, Reseller Bro.

To kick things off, we are producing two fully written, comedic time-travel skits that introduce the app. For this project and future others, you must have an excellent grasp of comedic timing and the ability to craft high-quality app UI motion graphics to show off the app on screen.

Beyond this initial launch, I have a massive pipeline of short-form and long-form video content lined up for the next year in Las Vegas. I am looking to find a true creative partner—whoever I vibe with best and who can execute this vision will be locked in as our go-to media creator for the entire long-term campaign.

What I will provide: "For the right person"

Pay 30–40 USD per hour + Equity package

The actor (myself)

Location (thrift store)

Full script (1 Short teaser-15 second intro video & 1 Longer ~2-minute explanation video).

Reseller Bro (functioning App.)

What I need from you:

Dynamic, fast-paced filming & editing matching a comedic, skit-style tone (For all Social Media Platforms).

Sound design (muffled thrift store background noise, tech sound effects for the app scan).

Please include links of your work, specifically any projects where you integrated app screens or UI graphics into live-action footage.

Check out the landing page and video for Reseller Bro below

[www.resellerbro.com](https://www.resellerbro.com/)

items.text:
Casting Call for “Trailer Trash: The Second Helping”, a short film.

**Synopsis: **“Trailer Trash: The Second Helping” is an R-rated comedy that follows up on the wild antics of a few poor small town North Carolina rednecks going about their daily drama-filled lives. This will be the sequel to the first Trailer Trash which you can check out right now on youtube. 

[Trailer Trash](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Adts7TwPqwo&t=585s)

Genre: Slightly Obscene Redneck Comedy

Title: Trailer Trash The Second Helping

Production Type: Independent

Director: Clayton Christopher Wood

Producer: Clayton Christopher Wood

Compensation: Gas money 

**Audition Information:**

We are currently only accepting video auditions, have yours in by August 20th to be considered for a role.

**Locations**** :** Mamers, North Carolina,  

**Shooting Dates: Saturday September 19th, Sunday September 20th**

Must be available from 10:00 am. to 7:00 pm Saturday, and 11:00 to 7:00 pm on Sunday.  Keep in mind times are not exact, we may finish early some days or later on others depending on how the shoots go. 

**Meals will be provided. Main acting roles will be paid**

**Character Descriptions: **

**Dale**: 6-10 year old boy or girl, preferably with either red or brown hair who can follow directions well and must be accompanied by a parent. 

**Junior**: 6-10 year boy or girl preferably with red or brown hair who can follow directions well and must be accompanied by a parent.

**Angel**: A very attractive southern blonde female between the ages of 45 and 55 with an ample bust, who has an aura about her that seems almost Angelic. 

**Hoggymama** - Annoying elderly redneck woman at the Pig Pickin’ who constantly tells boring irrelevant stories to anyone around who will listen, and will keep raving on even after people quit listening.

**Extras: **We will need at least 10-15 extras who will be fed and compensated with gas money depending on how far they have to drive. Each extra will play a redneck at a pig pickin, and are free to come up with their own redneck costume or provide us with sizes and we can put together a costume for you to wear

If you are interested, please contact the email below or call or text me at (919) 475-0274 to receive the sides for the character. 

[Claytonwood88@gmail.com](mailto:Claytonwood88@gmail.com)

Thank you for your time! We look forward to hearing from you.

🧙‍♂️ Wizard Performer Wanted – Edinburgh

I’m looking for confident, outgoing freelance performers to join an established street-based wizard photo experience in the heart of Edinburgh.

This is a performance-led role combining character work, public interaction, and a simple instant print setup.

🎭 The Role

You’ll be:
✨ Dressed as a wizard
✨ Engaging the public in busy locations
✨ Creating fun, spontaneous photo moments
✨ Encouraging people to take part (this is key)
✨ Operating a simple instant print system (full training provided)

This is not a passive role. You’ll need to be comfortable approaching strangers, starting conversations, and bringing energy to the street. If you enjoy performing and making people smile, you’ll fit right in.

💷 The Pay

💰 Structured performance-based pay
💰 Guaranteed day rate
💰 Strong performers can earn £250–£300+ per day
🧾 Paid via invoice within 24 hours

🕛 The Shift

🕛 12:00pm–5:00pm
📍 Victoria Street / Cockburn Street, Edinburgh

Shifts are available immediately.

👀 I’m Looking For People Who:

✔ Are confident approaching strangers
✔ Have a strong personality and stage presence
✔ Enjoy performing or entertaining
✔ Can work independently
✔ Are reliable, punctual and consistent

ℹ️ Please Note

This is not a Fringe Festival role. No accommodation or travel expenses are provided, so applicants should already be based in or able to travel to Edinburgh.

📩 To Apply

Hello. 41yo based in Kent.
Would love to get involved in becoming a background extra, short or long projects.

No acting experience, but willing to do as much learning as it needs. 

If anyone could point me in some useful directions.

Thank You

topComments.text:
Hi Matt,

A good starting point would be to get a few clear headshots taken, or take some yourself against a plain background in natural light. You want a clean face/head-and-shoulders photo and a full-length photo.

Also take your measurements when you get chance. You can Google how to measure for casting, but the main ones are usually height, head, collar, chest, waist, hips, inside leg and shoe size.

For extra/background work, sign up to Entertainment Partners (google this and you'll easily find it) and create a full profile. Add as much detail as possible: photos, measurements, location, skills, accents, transport and availability. If you drive, that helps a lot. 

Once set up, you can receive availability requests for supporting artist work.

Also keep an eye on Facebook groups for “casting calls”, “extras wanted”, “supporting artists” and “film/TV work” in your area. Kent, London and South East groups are probably the best places to start.

When applying, keep messages short and professional. Include your name, age, location, availability, whether you drive, and attach clear photos.

Best of luck with it 🤝

Be good at something besides acting be passionate about other things too…

2 days after winning his first Oscar at 31:

Conga time!  #congas #percussion #marlonbrando #Brando #actors

https://youtu.be/ZkF2-ZZSx6k?feature=shared

Trivia:  Marlon Brando

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Although he received four patents prior to his death in 2004, Brando likely needed to put in more work to make his creation a reality; one drum manufacturer interviewed for a 2011 NPR article indicated that the actor’s design was practical, but not cost-effective enough for production.

❗️Періодично компанія проводить зйомки рекламних або трендових відео для TikTok (Douyin). Зазвичай після роботи або між шоу!

🔸️ Всі артисти компанії самостійно сплачують збори за посвідку на проживання (residence permit) у розмірі 400 юанів на 3-6 місяців.

🔸️ Компанія оплачує тільки 1 міжнародний переліт і тільки в бік Китаю або 1 квиток всередині Китаю.

✅️ Харчування: 3 рази

✅️ Проживання: 2 чол/кімната
